text: KDDI Corporation's major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 15.77%), KYOCERA Corporation (14.75%), TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION (9.54%) and Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 6.63%); national and local governments hold 0.00% of its shares and no state or sovereign shareholder is listed as controlling the company. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (code 9433).
short: KDDI is Tokyo-listed; top holders are trust banks and industrial companies, no state control.
